value.body: A school nurse runs the school's sick room: giving first aid, handling minor illnesses, managing medicines for children with known conditions, and deciding when a child needs a doctor or a parent. Employers include private and residential schools and some colleges. A typical day involves attending to students, routine health checks and record-keeping.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: GNM, or B.Sc Nursing; ANM for some day schools

items.label: Registration
items.value: State Nursing Council registration commonly required

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Schools usually hire registered nurses with some hospital experience, though freshers are also considered by day schools. Boarding schools often need a nurse to live on campus.

value.title: At a glance
items: Hours are more regular than in hospitals, but the role is often a single-nurse post.
Next roles: senior school nurse, health coordinator, community or occupational health roles.
